notes: PIPELINE: overwrite this file weekly. The /board page imports it at build time. Do not add listing photos, QR codes, scores, or an archive of past weeks.
Tally counts (HOLD / NEW / MOVER / SOLD / IN CONTRACT / WAIT) are computed from listings[].status and listings[].bandCall. Never type the tally into this file.

VISUAL SAMPLE (Raphi, Oct 1): this week's movement is placeholder data so the board can show HOLD, NEW, MOVER and WAIT. Every field listed in a listing's sample array is invented; the page must carry a SAMPLE DATA bar.

Real (from the Sep 28 board): last week's three #1s, their asks, neighborhoods, calls and WHO lines; 221 W 77th #16 and 50 W 66th #5D WHO lines; the 50 W 66th $12.3M to $12.8M fair value read; the 'what would prove it wrong' lines.
Sample (invented): week of Oct 5, all this-week statuses, the $12,750,000 cut on 50 W 66th #5D, the $15M to $20M NEW listing (a named placeholder, not a real address), the Did the call hold results.
guidance: Bands are the shelf. #1 only per band. HOLD / NEW / MOVER / SOLD / IN CONTRACT / WAIT. Three listings, not a tournament. No leaderboard, fight card, or score.
Calls are words only: Pick / Consider / Wait / Pass, plus one WHO line. A #1 can still be a Pass. Do not manufacture a pick.
Copy rules: no em or en dashes, no listing photos, no QR codes, no 'real estate advisor', no guarantees.
